handoff_root.title: Handoff root
handoff_root.description: Folder for handoffs and saved summary copies; buckets are <root>/<repo>/<ticket-or-topic>/.

log_dir.title: Log folder
log_dir.description: Watcher logs and per-compaction records. Empty = <handoff root>/.watch.

disposable_root.title: Disposable evidence root
disposable_root.description: Automatic evidence copies, in dated folders.

disposable_keep_days.title: Disposable keep days
disposable_keep_days.description: Retention note only; the plugin deletes nothing. 0 = kept until removed.

evidence_quota_mb.title: Evidence quota (MB)
evidence_quota_mb.description: Per-bucket evidence size that triggers a warning; warn only.

queue_cmd.title: Queue command
queue_cmd.description: Executable for an optional question queue: answers `list --json --session <sid>` with a `queue-stub/v1` object (the version tag is required), `adopt --lane <id> [--if-free] [--must-exist]` and `add --json ...` (draft on stdin; exit codes in README). Empty = off: the plugin makes no queue call. Read from your settings file only (flags and env are ignored).

triggers.title: Plugin compactions
triggers.description: false = no plugin compactions, no nudge, no auto-continue; shaping, saving and verification still run.

compact_target_tokens.title: Compaction target (tokens)
compact_target_tokens.description: Plugin compaction at a clean turn end at or above this.

compact_soft_max_tokens.title: Soft maximum (tokens)
compact_soft_max_tokens.description: Mid-turn nudge at or above this.

native_window_tokens.title: Native window (tokens)
native_window_tokens.description: Your native auto-compact window, for the clamp. 0 = the session's context window.

boundary_delay_ms.title: Boundary delay (ms)
boundary_delay_ms.description: Delay before a turn-end compaction (500 ms after a nudge).

max_auto_continues_per_hour.title: Auto-continues per hour
max_auto_continues_per_hour.description: Cap on automatic continues in a rolling hour; 0 = never auto-continue, so every nudged cycle is a last cycle.

handoff_turn.title: Handoff turn
handoff_turn.description: halt = before the last compaction of a run that will not auto-continue, one more turn writes a handoff; off = no handoff turn.

handoff_turn_max_tokens.title: Handoff turn allowance (tokens)
handoff_turn_max_tokens.description: Tokens the handoff turn may use; reserved below the native trigger.

precompact_turn.title: Pre-compaction handoff turn
precompact_turn.description: model = before each planned compaction the model gets one extra turn to write a handoff; code = code records the checkpoint alone, which saves usage. Any other value counts as code.

measured_block.title: Measured facts to the summarizer
measured_block.description: Send the measured facts block to the summarizer (plugin path only).

auto_evidence.title: Automatic evidence copies
auto_evidence.description: Copy the temp files a session cited into the disposable root after a compaction.

warn_ui.title: Warnings in the interface
warn_ui.description: Toasts and status line for escalations.

watcher.title: Watcher
watcher.description: Local content-free compaction logs (shadow) or off. Nothing is sent; share with /{{plugin}}:report.

stall_min.title: Stall threshold (minutes)
stall_min.description: Minutes without progress before the watcher calls work stalled.

cache_ttl_s.title: Cache TTL (seconds)
cache_ttl_s.description: Warm/cold prompt-cache proxy used by the watcher.

otel_log_path.title: OpenTelemetry log path
otel_log_path.description: Read only if you already write it. Empty = unused.

deny_class_patterns.title: Permission-denial classes
deny_class_patterns.description: Patterns that class permission denials. Empty = the shipped classes.

repo_roots.title: Repositories for repo mode
repo_roots.description: Main checkouts, separated by ';', that may also receive published handoffs when the repository declares it in .claude/handoffs.json. Read from your settings file only (flags and env are ignored). Empty = none.

relaunch_auto.title: Automatic relaunch
relaunch_auto.description: on = relaunch a lost background job by itself when every check passes; shadow = log the verdict, always ask; off = always ask. Read from your settings file only (flags and env are ignored).

relaunch_allow.title: Relaunch allowlist
relaunch_allow.description: Patterns (each starts ^), separated by ';', for repeat-safe local commands that may start again by themselves after a lost-job check. A chained command, an outward step or a production command always asks. Read from your settings file only (flags and env are ignored).

relaunch_quiet_s.title: Relaunch quiet window (seconds)
relaunch_quiet_s.description: Seconds without output before a lost job counts as quiet when its end time is unknown.

unattended_prod_reads.title: Unattended production reads
unattended_prod_reads.description: forbid = a resumed session asks before any production step; allow = a read-only production check the session builds itself may run without asking. Production writes and commands from a handoff always ask. Read from your settings file only (flags and env are ignored).

prod_patterns.title: Production patterns
prod_patterns.description: Extra patterns, separated by ';', that mark a command as production, beside the shipped prod-token class. They can only make the plugin ask more. Empty = the shipped class only.

idle_handoff_turn.title: Pre-idle handoff turn
idle_handoff_turn.description: on = when the session has been idle for about 49 minutes, the model gets one turn to write a handoff before the prompt cache expires; off = none. Any other value counts as off.

idle_handoff_min_tokens.title: Pre-idle handoff minimum (tokens)
idle_handoff_min_tokens.description: No pre-idle handoff turn below this context size.
